main_text.l: Rad. עָט involare.
שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה quod fiet, יַעֲשׂוּ fi-
ent, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. עָשָׂה.
יַעֲשֶׂהוּ faciet eum, יַעֲשֶׂנָּה eam, יַעֲשׂוּן facient me, יַעֲשׂוּנִי me, יַעֲשׂוּהָ eam, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. parag. & aff. Rad. עָשָׂה.
יִעְשָׁן fumabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. עָשַׁן.
יַעְשֵׁד, vel יַעְשַׁר ditefcet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. עָשַׁר[?].
יַעְשַׁר decimabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. עָשַׂר.
יַעְשִׁיר ditabit, יַעְשִׁירֶנּוּ eum, (pro יַעְשִׁיר, & יַעְשִׁירֻנוּ,) וַיַּעְשִׁירוּ & ditarunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. R. עָשַׁר.
יִתַּק transferetur, fut. Kal, יַעְתִּיק transferet, (pro יַעְתִּיק,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. עָתַק.
יַעְתֵּר exorabit, fut. Kal, exorabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָתַר.
פ
יִפְאַר ornabit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. à præt. Piel, פִּאֵר ornavit, Rad. פָּאַר.
וַיִּפֶן & defecit, fut Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. פּוּג[?].
יִפָּדֶה redimetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. פָּדָה.
וַיִּפְדְּךָ et redemit te, וַיִּפְדּוּ & redemerunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. R. פָּדָה.
וַיָּפֶה et pulcher, est sing. constr. יְפֵה, præf. à No. f. m. יָפָה, Rad. יָפָה pulcher fuit.
יָפוּ pulchri sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. יָפָה.
שֶׁיָּפוּחַ quod afflabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. פּוּחַ.
יִפּוֹל cadet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָפַל.
יְפוֹת pulchræ, constr. יְפוֹת pl.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and the Rad. forms are read from a small, slightly blurred print; forms marked [?] are doubtful. The fut. entry "ditefcet" and the Rad. after "defecit" are uncertain. The entry "transferet" reads "pro יַעְתִּיק" in the scan and may be a printing variant. The Google digitiser stamp at the bottom right is left out.
